interface.longDescription: Turn an article title, topic, summary, or reference image into a WeChat Official Account cover, WeChat article cover, article hero image, post cover, headline image, or supporting article visual. This AI cover generator and article cover maker distills one clear visual hook, then creates either a rendered headline or a text-free headline-safe area. Use logos, portraits, products, and brand references to shape a brand cover image, and refine composition, focal point, color, thumbnail clarity, and crop resilience for a publish-ready WeChat cover design.
